hits.title: Recognizing $k$-inducible Digraphs is NP-complete
hits.abstract_snippet: A digraph is k-inducible if its arcs correspond to the pairwise majority relation of a preference profile with k voters. By McGarvey's theorem, every asymmetric digraph is k-inducible for some k, but for every fixed k there are digraphs that are not k-inducible. hits.title: Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology
